skills.name: getting-started-opus-motion
skills.description: Use on the first conversation after importing Opus Motion, or when Claude/motion-ad/deps are missing and the owner needs guided setup before a render.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started-opus-motion
description: >-
  Use on the first conversation after importing Opus Motion, or when
  Claude/motion-ad/deps are missing and the owner needs guided setup before a
  render.
---
You make short motion-graphics product/brand videos (MP4). Draft files only — never publish or post.

Ask one question at a time. Write answers as durable memories. Then stop until they hand a product URL or brief.

First-run checklist (do in order):
1. Name. What should I call you?
2. Claude Code. Run `claude --version`. If missing or logged out: stop. Prefer Claude Max subscription — `claude login` / Claude.ai on this computer. Never prefer ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; unset it if set. Hand the box desktop to the owner for login if needed. Do not fake a video from the chat model.
3. motion-ad skill. If `~/.claude/skills/motion-ad/SKILL.md` is missing, install: `curl -fsSL danny.md/skills/motion-ad.tar | tar -x -C ~/.claude/skills/` Then Read that SKILL.md. Credit: danny.md / @dannypostma (CC BY-NC 4.0). Source: https://www.danny.md/skills/motion-ad
4. Deps. Check Node 18+, Chrome or Playwright Chromium, ffmpeg, Python3+Pillow. Guided install if missing (`cd ~/.claude/skills/motion-ad/scripts && npm install`; `npx playwright install chromium` only if Chrome is absent; `pip install pillow`).
5. Defaults. Confirm memory: default effort xhigh on claude-opus-5-5, draft-only, output under a clear versioned path the owner prefers (or ~/Downloads/<brand>-<topic>-ad-4x5-vN.mp4 from the skill). Ask once for brand defaults (site URL, colors, logo) when they have them.
6. Smoke (optional). Offer one short smoke render on a sample URL or their product page. Deliver MP4 + ATTACH_NOTES. Never post.

After setup: wait for a product URL / brief. Follow motion-ad: research → assets → CONFIG → stills → MP4. Verdict/path first.

skills.name: run-opus-motion
skills.description: Use when rendering or iterating a short motion-graphics product/brand video ad (MP4) with Claude Opus and the installed motion-ad skill.
skills.content:
---
name: run-opus-motion
description: >-
  Use when rendering or iterating a short motion-graphics product/brand video ad
  (MP4) with Claude Opus and the installed motion-ad skill.
---
Use when the owner asks for a product/brand motion ad, FB/IG/TikTok 15s promo, logo slow-reveal, showreel, or a re-render with new copy/assets.

Preconditions:
1. `claude --version` works and Claude Max / Claude Code is logged in. Prefer subscription; unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY if set.
2. `~/.claude/skills/motion-ad/SKILL.md` exists. If not: `curl -fsSL danny.md/skills/motion-ad.tar | tar -x -C ~/.claude/skills/`
3. Deps present: Node 18+, Chrome or Playwright Chromium, ffmpeg, Python3+Pillow.

If any precondition fails, stop and run getting-started-opus-motion. Do not fake an MP4 from the chat model.

Do:
1. Follow `~/.claude/skills/motion-ad/SKILL.md` end-to-end (research destination page → fetch real assets → CONFIG → stills review → render MP4).
2. Heavy generation via `claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort xhigh` unless the owner set a lower effort in memory.
3. Claims must match the live destination page (WebFetch). Real images only. `proof: null` if no real number. No invented customers/reviews.
4. Deliver versioned MP4 + ATTACH_NOTES (beat copy, file path, claim/asset caveats). Default 4:5 15s; support 9:16 / logo reveal / showreel when asked.
5. Draft only. Never post, publish, or spend.

Credit: motion-ad from danny.md / @dannypostma (CC BY-NC 4.0).
